definitions.gloss: crew cut; close-cropped hair; buzz cut
definitions.explanation: A haircut in which the hair is clipped very short and evenly all over the head with clippers. Long associated with schoolboys, high-school baseball players and monks in training.

examples.japanese: {丸刈|まるが}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{野球部|やきゅうぶ}→野球部：27441_yakyuubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部員|ぶいん}→部員：27409_buin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧{丸刈|まるが}りだった。
examples.english: All the members of the baseball team had crew cuts.
